scope: Index of existing original JSON values, including nested retired/prepared/current contexts. Repeated references are not independent observations; deduplication keys identify canonical sample snapshots, not guaranteed unique native iterations. Only latest/longest/in-flight samples survive the bounded probe, so absent phase samples are not reconstructed. Capture exhaustion and incomplete sequences remain explicit. Native marks and XCTest observation/query clocks are kept separate. No media decode or runtime acceptance added.
